'''Deulo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3640 BBY]] he was posted on [[Voss]], where he commanded a group of soldiers from a base called the [[Hawk's Nest]] located in the [[Old Paths]]. As callsign "Harrier One" he contacted [[General/Legends|General]] [[Thelonia Redrish]], callsign "Peregrine" and informed her that the Hawk's Nest was compromised after an Imperial attack, to which Redrish replied that more were on the way and ordered to destroy the base and all evidence in the "Operation Cave-in." However, as the commandos were setting charges, they were ambushed by a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] before they were ready for detonation. Deulo and his men were all killed in the resulting firefight.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Colonel Deulo appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during a Bounty Hunter class mission on Voss.
